name: Kirkland Signature Solid White Albacore Tuna in Water (Canned 8-Pack)
whyItWorks: Solid loins of albacore tuna packed in water without added vegetable oils or broths. Packs over 30g of pure, easily digested protein per can with zero carbohydrates or insoluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain water thoroughly. Eat plain or seasoned with a touch of salt and olive oil. Avoid mixing with raw onions, celery, or relish.
